description: Restores the specified incident from the recycle bin, making it active again. The incident and all its associated records (injuries, near_misses, attachments, etc.) are recovered. Returns 200 OK on success with the incident's ID and number. Pass renumber as true to give the restored incident the next available number instead of its original one, for example when an active incident already uses it.

number.description: The incident's number after the restore

renumber.description: When true, the restored incident is assigned the next available incident number for the project, even if its original number is not in use. When false or omitted, the original number is kept.
